reusable_lessons.lesson: Always use adjudicated claims as the denominator when calculating claim-based rates (denial, fraud, approval, etc.), whether aggregated by group or at provider level. Non-adjudicated claims cannot have a denial or fraud outcome, so including them in the denominator distorts rate calculations.
